messages:
eva: hi everyone :wave: quick onboarding Q — where do I grab a sandbox vs hosted (prod) API key? also what's the sandbox quota/rate-limit for new hires so I can schedule a demo without surprises?

mike: welcome! sandbox keys are auto-created on signup and visible under Console -> Sandbox (copy the key there). Hosted/prod keys are created by org admins under Console -> API Keys; those are billing-enabled and require an admin to create.

sophie: FYI default new-hire sandbox: $40 promo credits and a soft cap of ~75k tokens/month. Rate limits: steady ~8 reqs/sec per key with a short burst allowance up to ~25 reqs/sec for a few seconds. If you exceed bursts you may see 429 + Retry-After.

eva: thanks — who do I ask to get a temporary bump for a 10-minute live demo or a staging key for load tests?

devex-bot: To request a demo/staging bump open a ticket at https://go/redwood-help (choose "Sandbox/demo quota") or @mention infra in this channel. For sustained increases include expected token volume and the test window.

infra: we can issue time-limited demo keys (10-30min) if you send demo time + reason. For load tests we prefer you use a staging org/service account so you don't burn promo credits.

mike: quick security tips: never commit keys. Use env var REDWOOD_API_KEY or store in Vault (path: secret/redwood/api). For CI use your CI provider's secrets store. Rotate keys if leaked.

sophie: sample snippets you can paste into your demo environment:

Node (SDK):
const redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1-small', input: 'hi' });

curl (simple):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1-mini","input":"hello"}'

mike: also watch response headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After. Implement exponential backoff on 429s.

eva: who signs off hosted keys for production? I need a key with customer-data scope for a demo pipeline.

devex-bot: Hosted keys that include customer-data access require org admin creation plus a security sign-off. Email security@redwood.com with justification and loop in your manager. An audit log entry is required.

eva: awesome, thanks all. i'll open the help ticket and DM infra with the demo time. :thumbsup:
